title: Make it click
text: What if math stopped feeling like a wall of symbols? Meet Catalyst. See the idea. Try it. Make it click.

title: Start your copy
text: Install Python, extract the offline ZIP, and open Start Catalyst on Windows. On Mac or Linux, run python three start dot py. Open the local address in your browser.

title: Find your starting point
text: Start with a placement check, or choose a course. Explore narrated lessons from counting to college mathematics, one idea at a time.

title: Learn by doing
text: Watch, then try three problems right below. Stuck? See an example, reveal why a step works, or open the calculator.

title: Make it real
text: Now make it real. Change an orbit. Test a gear ratio. Train a tiny model. Move the controls and see what your math actually does.

title: Keep your progress
text: Fresh independent checks earn stars on your skill tree. Your work saves automatically. Come back, review, and keep growing.

title: Start one idea
text: Free, open source, and yours to explore. Start with one idea. Build from there. Catalyst.
